title: Ram Narayan v. Managing Director, Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Vipin Chandra Dixit, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; petitioner directed to apply under Clause 6.5.
headnote: A consumer seeking a mandamus to decide a bill-dispute application and reconnect supply was directed to raise all grievances under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, with a timed hearing and reasoned order; the writ was disposed of without deciding the bill or reconnection.
facts: Ram Narayan, a consumer of Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, filed a writ under Article 226 seeking a mandamus that respondent no. 2 decide his application dated 9 November 2024 disputing an electricity bill, and a further mandamus to reconnect his supply. The petition was listed as fresh in February 2025 and heard on 5 April 2025.

holding_units.holding: A consumer who seeks a court-directed decision on an electricity-bill dispute and reconnection must raise all grievances by application under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if that application is filed within two weeks, the concerned authority shall grant a hearing and pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within six weeks.

not_decided.point: Merits of the electricity-bill dispute raised in the 9 November 2024 application
not_decided.note: Relegated to a Clause 6.5 application and a reasoned order by the concerned authority.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner’s supply should be reconnected
not_decided.note: No mandamus to reconnect; left to the Clause 6.5 process.
